verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature. The only way out is indirect: the SDK can fetch specific docs back from an index (moss-docs-22), and the Node/Python SDKs can cache downloaded indexes to local disk (moss-docs-24), so a user could script retrieval of their data. Self-supplied vectors via the custom model option (moss-docs-17) also mean embeddings need not be locked to Moss. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, a stated open export format (JSON/Parquet/etc.) for documents, embeddings and metadata, guidance on migrating off or deleting your account, and any independent corroboration.
